# External data

Downloaded by `scripts/fetch_external.py`; the fetch date is in `FETCHED`. Both files are published by
Epoch AI under CC-BY 4.0.

| file | source | used for |
|---|---|---|
| `epoch_eci_scores.csv` | https://epoch.ai/data/eci_scores.csv (Epoch Capabilities Index, https://epoch.ai/eci) | public ECI of the models on the capability-versus-uplift page; the ECI-to-compute fit |
| `epoch_notable_ai_models.csv` | https://epoch.ai/data/notable_ai_models.csv (Data on Notable AI Models) | training compute estimates for the ECI-to-compute fit |
